Package com.radiantlogic.iddm.base

Interface Response

All Known Subinterfaces:
AuthenticationResponse, ConnectionResponse, CreateResponse, DataProvider<OUT>, DeleteResponse, ExtractSchemaResponse, ModifyResponse, SearchResponse, SequentialDataProvider<OUT>
All Known Implementing Classes:
LdapResponse, ResponseEntity, TestConnectionResponse
public interface Response
Identifies an object as a return value eligible for processing by the IDDM connector framework.

To use, the developer creates a new class that implements this interface. Doing this marks the concrete implementation as a response that can be returned to the connector framework.

It is strongly recommended (but not required) that developers use an existing implementation, such as ResponseEntity, instead of directly implementing this interface.
